subject: Storage lane partner intake — Nebula Data (Pinecone + S3 fallback)
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@nebula-data.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: partners@pinecone.io, procurement@nebula-data.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — storage lane partnership idea

Hi Stephanie — great to meet (virtually) earlier this week. Nebula is excited to explore a co-sell/integration with Redwood focused on customers that want Pinecone + S3 cold lanes for large-scale vector stores. A couple of pragmatic asks from our side to scope the intake: 

- Can you share a simple checklist of platform hooks we need to support (auth, fallback routing, blob lifecycle)?
- Security: can Redwood confirm the expected data residency and KMS model when S3 is used as a cold tier (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed)?
- Commercial: we typically do reseller or referral-style GTM. Would love to see a rough mutual action plan and commitment milestones.

Attaching a one-page vendor intake we filled out. I looped in procurement to start the procurement cadence. Looking forward to a quick intake call next week — available Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Cheers,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Partnerships | Nebula Data

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@nebula-data.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storage lane partner intake — Nebula Data (Pinecone + S3 fallback)

Tom — thanks for the clear asks and for filling out the intake. High level responses inline and a proposed next-step plan below.

- Hooks/checklist: we've attached our "storage-lane-integration-checklist.xlsx" that lists the minimal integration points (auth token exchange, index routing flag, S3 URI mapping, tombstone/TTL semantics). Our runtime expects a small adapter (HTTP endpoint) that returns placement decisions and a KV for prefix cache invalidation.

- Data residency & KMS: Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) in our Private and Dedicated products. For Hosted we support customer KMS via envelope encryption with region controls; we will share the whitepaper.

- Commercial: we can run a staged MAP: evaluation pilot (30 days), joint case study, then a marketplace listing with referral split. I'll propose milestones below.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Intake sync (30 min) — Tue 2027-06-01 10:00 PT (tentative)
2) Technical spike: Nebula devs to run a small adapter against our staging runtime (2wk)
3) Legal/commercial: exchange MA draft (I attached our template) — procurement to start redlines
4) GTM: draft co-marketing plan and joint one-pager

I've attached a draft MA and the integration checklist. Marissa — can you own the staging environment access? Ben — can you lead the engineering handshake on our side? Karthik/Laura — please prep GTM/marketplace notes for the call.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

From: partners@pinecone.io
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@nebula-data.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storage lane partner intake — Nebula Data (Pinecone + S3 fallback)

Thanks for the loop, Tom / Stephanie. Pinecone partner engineering here — quick notes from our side:

- We've built a small adapter pattern similar to what Stephanie described (placement decision + cold-tier pointer). We can share a reference implementation that Nebula can use as a template.
- For compatibility, ensure your S3 object metadata preserves segment offsets for efficient range reads (helps reduce I/O during retrieval).
- We recommend implementing a predictable key schema so Pinecone can map vectors to warm vs cold buckets deterministically.

We can join the technical spike call and share the reference adapter repo.

— Pinecone Partner Eng

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Storage lane partner intake — Nebula Data (Pinecone + S3 fallback)

All — quick internal sync notes after the intake thread. Updates and owners: 

- Marissa: will provision a staging Pinecone namespace and temp S3 bucket (ETA Wed 06/02).
- Ben: will draft the adapter acceptance criteria (latency SLOs, routing API, cache invalidation hook).
- Karthik: will own commercial terms and coordinate the MA redline with procurement (send to Tom and cc procurement@nebula-data.com).
- Laura: drafting 1-pager GTM use cases (search + recall with cost control) for the intake call.

We should keep the pilot narrowly scoped: demo 3 customers, validate 10M vectors with cold lane fallthrough, and confirm unit read cost under our target.

I scheduled the intake call for Tue 06/01 10:00 PT — calendar invites to follow.

-Marissa
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
